flagged.evidence: The title says “Correlated inputs create a high-variance common initialization mode,” while the Example specifies “orthonormal inputs $x_i=e_i$.” Proof step 2.1 attributes the off-diagonal feature covariance to the positive activation mean. The title attributes the effect to correlated inputs, contrary to the example’s setup.

The title says “The analyzed residual network skips at every layer,” but the Example defines $x^{(1)}=\sqrt{c_\sigma/m}\,\sigma(W^{(1)}x)$ with no identity skip. Only the subsequent layers add the preceding representation.

The Statement defines $q=1+\log(16/\delta)$ and $M=\sqrt{1+\log(16mnH/\delta)}$, then claims probability at least $1-\delta$, but gives no range for $\delta$. The logarithms and square root require a domain restriction; the usual confidence range $0<\delta<1$ is not stated.
